citations.excerpt: Apache resolution times are strongly heavy-tailed, while 94-100% of arrivals in the primary issue trackers enter queues estimated to be at or above capacity

citations.label: arXiv 2608.28509, rethinking vulnerability remediation as a capacity allocation problem

citations.label: arXiv 2608.28509, rethinking vulnerability remediation as a capacity allocation problem
citations.excerpt: Flow-control analyses show larger operational effects: transitions from overloaded to draining queues are associated with shorter resolution times, severity-first sequencing reduces critical-item delay at fixed capacity, and capacity reservation can reduce prolonged critical-item delays

citations.label: arXiv 2608.28509, rethinking vulnerability remediation as a capacity allocation problem
citations.excerpt: Owner-level analyses further show that available capacity is useful only when it is located where demand occurs or can be transferred through relevant expertise connections
